name: City Donut
description: Located on the beautiful Alabama Gulf Coast, City Donut has earned a special place in the hearts of Orange Beach residents and visitors alike. Recognized as the #1 Donut Shop in the 2024 USA Today's Readers Poll, this beloved family-owned establishment has been the community's go-to destination for fresh, handcrafted donuts and delightful ice cream treats since 2013. City Donut distinguishes itself by being a true local gem, proudly independent and locally owned. Behind its warm atmosphere lies a dedicated team of bakers who work through the night and day to create made-from-scratch donuts with a commitment to quality and tradition. The shop offers a variety of classic yeast and cake donuts, with occasional seasonal or creative flavors that surprise and delight customers. Because the selection changes daily based on what's freshly prepared, early visits are rewarded with the best choices and the freshest bites. Beyond donuts, City Donut's comprehensive ice cream menu satisfies those with a sweet tooth seeking creamy indulgence. From rich shakes to classic sundaes and banana splits, their offerings complement the bakery's specialties, making it a perfect spot for a sweet escape at any time of day. As a family-run business thriving on community and visitors' support, City Donut exemplifies the charm and dedication that characterize true small-town success stories. Its continued popularity reflects a deeper appreciation for authentic, handcrafted treats and a welcoming spirit. For folks craving a delicious start to the day or a comforting afternoon treat, City Donut has you covered. Looking ahead, City Donut is sure to inspire more sweet moments and cherished memories in Orange Beach, keeping the tradition of fresh donuts alive for years to come.
address_line_1: 25751 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA
